knowledge:
- key_parameters: files=Character vector containing paths of BAM or BED files to be analyzed ;; filetype=Character, either "bam" or "bed" indicating format of input file ;; genomeName=The code of the genome to use as reference (e.g., "mm9"), strongly recommended ;; binSize=Integer size in base pairs of the minimum window for scanning (default 50) ;; minWin=Integer indicating the minimum window size in base pairs (default 50) ;; maxWin=Integer indicating the maximum allowed window size in units of 50 bp (default 1000) ;; zthresh=Cutoff value for z-scores in findPeaks (default 10) ;; zThreshold=Z-score for considering a peak for alignment in finalRegions, must be equal or higher to the zthresh used in findPeaks (default 20) ;; minCarriers=Minimum number of biological replicates required to overlap after aligning peaks for reporting ;; save/saveFlag=Flag indicating if the output has to be saved to disk ;; BPPARAM=A BiocParallel BPPARAM object to allow for parallel computing (e.g., BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(2))
- alternatives: EDASeq::betweenLaneNormalization and RUVSeq::RUVs are used for normalization instead of total library count-based methods, which are inappropriate for epigenetic sequencing experiments because differences in total counts can be due to the treatment of interest. edgeR is used for downstream differential enrichment testing.
- when_to_use: Use this workflow when analyzing epigenomic sequencing data (such as Sono-seq, ChIP-seq, or ATAC-seq) across multiple replicates and conditions to identify consensus differentially enriched genomic regions starting from raw alignment files.
- pitfalls: Do not use standard RNA-seq normalization methods based on total library counts, as treatment-induced biological differences in enrichment can be incorrectly normalized out. MulticoreParam() may have performance issues on macOS; use DoparParam() instead when working on Mac. Ensure that the zThreshold parameter in finalRegions is equal to or higher than the zthresh used in findPeaks.

workflows.name: differential_enrichment_workflow
workflows.intent: Identify differentially enriched genomic regions from raw BAM/BED alignment files across multiple replicates and conditions.
input: bam.files (character vector of paths to raw BAM alignment files)
peaksGRL_all_files.rds (pre-computed GRangesList of called peaks across replicates, optional if running findPeaks on all files)
workflows.stages: 1. Call peaks for each sample using findPeaks ;; 2. Align overlapping peaks across replicates to produce consensus regions using finalRegions ;; 3. Count reads in the final consensus regions using countFinalRegions ;; 4. Filter and format the count matrix ;; 5. Perform between-sample normalization using EDASeq and RUVSeq to control for unwanted variation ;; 6. Test for differential enrichment using edgeR negative binomial quasi-likelihood GLM
workflows.code:
library("DEScan2")
library("RUVSeq")
library("edgeR")
BiocParallel::register(BiocParallel::SerialParam())

bam.files <- list.files(system.file(file.path("extdata","bam"), 
                        package="DEScan2"),
                        pattern="bam$", full.names=TRUE)

peaksGRL <- DEScan2::findPeaks(files=bam.files[1], filetype="bam", genomeName="mm9",
    binSize=50, minWin=50, maxWin=1000, zthresh=10, minCount=0.1, sigwin=10,
    minCompWinWidth=5000, maxCompWinWidth=10000, save=FALSE,
    outputFolder="peaks", force=TRUE, onlyStdChrs=TRUE, chr=NULL, verbose=FALSE)

peaks.file <- system.file(
                file.path("extdata","peaks","RData","peaksGRL_all_files.rds"),
                package="DEScan2")

peaksGRL <- readRDS(peaks.file)
regionsGR <- DEScan2::finalRegions(peakSamplesGRangesList=peaksGRL, zThreshold=10,
                minCarriers=3, saveFlag=FALSE, outputFolder=NULL, verbose=FALSE)

head(regionsGR)

bam.path <- system.file(file.path("extdata","bam"), package="DEScan2")
finalRegions <- DEScan2::countFinalRegions(regionsGRanges=regionsGR, 
                    readsFilePath=bam.path, fileType="bam", minCarriers=1,
                    genomeName="mm9", onlyStdChrs=TRUE, saveFlag=FALSE,
                    verbose=FALSE)

counts <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(finalRegions)
regions <- SummarizedExperiment::rowRanges(finalRegions)

counts <- counts[regions$`k-carriers` >= 4, ]
counts <- counts[rowSums(counts) > 0,]
colnames(counts) <- c("FC1", "FC4", "HC1", "HC4", "FC6", "FC9", "HC6", "HC9")
counts <- counts[,order(colnames(counts))]
head(counts)

library("RColorBrewer")
colors <- brewer.pal(3, "Set2")
set <- EDASeq::betweenLaneNormalization(counts, which = "upper")
groups <- matrix(c(1:8), nrow=2, byrow=TRUE)
trt <- factor(c(rep("FC", 4), rep("HC", 4)))

EDASeq::plotRLE(set, outline=FALSE, ylim=c(-4, 4),
        col=colors[trt], main="No Normalization RLE")
EDASeq::plotPCA(set, col=colors[trt], main="No Normalization PCA", 
                labels=FALSE, pch=19)

k <- 4
s <- RUVSeq::RUVs(set, cIdx=rownames(set), scIdx=groups, k=k)

EDASeq::plotRLE(s$normalizedCounts, outline=FALSE, ylim=c(-4, 4), 
        col=colors[trt], main="Normalized RLE")
EDASeq::plotPCA(s$normalizedCounts, col=colors[trt], main="Normalized PCA",
        labels=FALSE, pch=19)

design <- model.matrix(~0 + trt + s$W)
colnames(design) <- c(levels(trt), paste0("W", 1:k))

y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts=counts, group=trt)
y <- edgeR::estimateDisp(y, design)

fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(y, design, robust=TRUE)

con <- limma::makeContrasts(FC - HC, levels=design)

qlf <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit, contrast=con)
res <- edgeR::topTags(qlf, n=Inf, p.value=0.05)
head(res$table)
dim(res$table)
regions[rownames(res$table)]
